schema: Every result cited by the README or dashboard traces to an entry here or another committed artifact. production_impact is 'none' for all; golden af8f2b32 byte-identical throughout.

experiments.name: Twelve prior measured negatives (dense embeddings, learned linear/logistic, LambdaMART v1/v2/v3, availability hedge, consensus calibration, quantified-impact density, gzip-NCD, DART test-time reranker, top-K cross-encoder, learned interactions)
experiments.hypothesis: A model/feature lever beats the hand-tuned scorer on the 100K blind arbiter

experiments.name: Rank-space fusion (RRF/Borda + top-lock)
experiments.hypothesis: Rank-space consensus beats score-space aggregation on the NDCG@50 tail
experiments.result: First alternative to clear holdout, but gain is anachronism-candidate promotion

experiments.name: fusion-raw vs golden (proxy gain audit)
experiments.hypothesis: fusion-raw is a robust improvement over golden
experiments.result: Downgraded: 1.85 effective judges; 56% of gain from 5 candidates; inverts to -0.011 without anachronism

experiments.name: Integrity-constrained fusion (two-level gate, hard-exclude)
experiments.result: Integrity gate works (0/0) but composite craters -0.13; correct only under world (A)

experiments.name: Information-architecture evidence channels (BM25F, requirement->evidence Hungarian, counterfactual masking)
experiments.hypothesis: Field-structured channels add independent signal that improves the proxy
experiments.result: Channels genuinely independent but none improve the proxy -> bottleneck is label-fidelity

experiments.name: Judge-dependence audit
experiments.hypothesis: The 7 label sets are independent witnesses
experiments.result: '7/7 improved' is really ~1.9 effective votes -> corrects an over-claim

experiments.name: Candidate-influence / deletion audit
experiments.hypothesis: The fusion gain is broadly distributed
experiments.result: 56% of gain from 5 candidates -> fails 'not dominated by a few rows'

experiments.name: Advanced directions (dual-head graded integrity, correlation-aware weighted RRF, AcuRank, conformal, SPLATE, ConFit)
experiments.hypothesis: A post-fusion refinement yields a robust proxy gain
experiments.result: Dual-head refuted (inverted baseline); weighted RRF refuted (independence != value); others out-by-constraint

experiments.name: Experiment Ω — causal / DRO ranking-decision system
experiments.hypothesis: Minimax-regret over judge-utility worlds selects a dominant ranking
experiments.dataset: SIMULATED reviewers (ground truth = blind tier + anachronism severity)
experiments.result: Decision NO_RANKING_DOMINATES; Ω regret 0 is by-construction, not independent validation
limitations: reviewers SIMULATED; λ is the (A)/(B) fork; SHIP_OMEGA gate unmet by construction

experiments.name: Experiment Ψ — minimal human integrity calibration (frozen instrument)
experiments.hypothesis: Real humans' integrity reversal rate resolves the (A)/(B) fork
experiments.result: Instrument frozen + pre-registered shipping rule; AWAITING_HUMAN_DATA
limitations: no human reviewers available in this environment

experiments.name: Study Φ / Φ-2 — public hiring-norms atlas (HN + Workplace SE)
experiments.hypothesis: Public discourse reveals the SHAPE of the integrity policy
experiments.dataset: REAL HN (Algolia) + Workplace SE (CC-BY-SA); n=27 combined
experiments.result: Severity-conditioned, verification-first surface; HR/process stratum more procedural than engineers

experiments.name: Downstream integrity audit cards (non-ranking explanation layer)
experiments.hypothesis: A two-axis state is more recruiter-authentic than honeypot=true/false
experiments.result: Annotation layer downstream of ranking; the 52 anomalies render VERIFY (not discard); golden byte-identical
